text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan is in the lead! Leading the 
pack, Mejiro Ardan crosses the finish 
line!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Haa—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I won, Creek-san's pressure 
still lingers vividly throughout my entire 
body...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Now that's the spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I know for certain... that I can have 
another all-out battle against Creek-san 
next time...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(For us... there is still a realm that 
lies further ahead...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (How truly joyful that is...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san... You truly are a terrifying 
person...!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Next time, without fail... I will defeat 
Ardan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...In this race, I gained something even 
more thrilling than the victory itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The fact that those whom I wish to 
surpass—those who could be my rivals—exist 
in great numbers right "now" at this very 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...A contest against them will surely be 
a magnificent one, worthy of dedicating my 
whole heart and soul to."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I was convinced.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As long as beloved rivals exist, the 
limits I am able to surpass are truly 
infinite—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance this body emits, the trail 
of light it traces, shall become 
infinitely dazzling...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle against a new 
formidable rival, Mejiro Ardan seemed to 
sense the first sprouts of her own growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...With the Classic year nearing its end, 
the battles against her rivals will only 
become even fiercer from here on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be best to take a breather before 
the next goal and focus on taking her 
abilities up another notch.
choice_data_list: Why don't we aim for the Osaka Hai next?
Why don't we aim for the Osaka Hai next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The "Osaka Hai"...! That's the classic 
route, the battle to determine the 
strongest spring medium-distance runner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure a magnificent radiance will 
gather there once again.
choice_data_list:
I'm already looking forward to competing 
*now*.

I'm already looking forward to competing 
*now*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really all right? For my heart to 
dance with this much joy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because surely that will turn her running 
into something even more dazzling and 
vivid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...If that is what you say, Trainer, then 
I can surrender myself to these feelings 
without any reservations."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back and review today's 
performance right away. I want to check 
Creek-san's run one more time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, unable to contain her soaring 
excitement, I hurried back to the academy 
together with Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at almost the exact same time—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Mejiro Ardan takes the lead! Mejiro 
Ardan is in front, and she crosses the 
line!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Amazing—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Creek-san, Yaeno-san, Ardan-san too... 
Everyone's getting... stronger and 
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And yet... I...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...It's okay. I can become even 
stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—No. I must become stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So that when Chiyono O-san returns 
someday... I will be worthy of being her 
rival...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—The Osaka Hai. There, I will surely shine 
even brighter...!
